description: Hello everyone! I am passionate about science, technology, space, and innovation. I enjoy learning, researching, and finding creative solutions. I want to join NASA Space Apps Challenge to gain experience, share ideas, and develop innovative projects. I am looking for creative, motivated, and team-oriented people with skills in programming, design, engineering, or research. Let's learn and create something amazing together!
summary: The goal of our project is to raise awareness about abandoned yet not-forgotten spacecraft and to encourage people to think about potential solutions regarding them. Currently, most people tend to overlook—or simply do not care about—these abandoned spacecraft. By informing the public on this subject, we aim to help reduce the accidents that occur as a result. Furthermore, through our presentation, we intend to convey this information in an engaging and enjoyable way. In short, the core purpose of our project is to inform people and empower them to develop solutions for this issue.
details: The benefit of our project is to raise awareness among people in an entertaining way. The websites and applications we used to create our project are Google, Canva, and Keynote.
